# MEDIOCRE!

*breathes through life-support mask*

Do not, my friends, become addicted to passing tests. It will take hold of you, and you will resent its absence. This code... THIS CODE will never ride eternal, shiny and chrome.

---

## Critical Severity

**SQL Injection - EVERYWHERE** (All resolvers)
Every single query uses string interpolation. EVERY. SINGLE. ONE.

```graphql
query { user(id: "1; DROP TABLE users; --") { name } }
```

The wasteland has more protection than this. Use parameterized queries: `pool.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [id])`

**Sensitive Data Exposure** (User type, lines 36-47)
```graphql
password: String!
ssn: String
resetToken: String
apiKey: String
```
You expose `password`, `ssn`, `resetToken`, and `apiKey` in the schema. Any query for a user returns their hashed password and SSN. This is not a codebase - it is a gift basket for data thieves.

**Full Credit Card Data** (CreditCard type, PaymentDetails type)
```graphql
number: String!
cvv: String!
fullCardNumber: String!
```
CVV AND full card numbers stored AND exposed. PCI-DSS will hunt you across the wasteland.

---

## High Severity

**No Authorization Checks** (All queries/mutations)
`adminStats` has no auth check. `updateUser` lets anyone modify any user. `processRefund` processes unlimited refunds without validation. Any War Boy can become Immortan.

**N+1 Query Apocalypse** (All nested resolvers)
```graphql
query { users { orders { items { product { reviews { user } } } } } }
```
Each nesting level triggers individual queries. Fetch 100 users → 100 order queries → hundreds of item queries → product queries → review queries. Your database will die in the salt flats.

**No Query Depth/Complexity Limits**
Infinite recursion possible: `User → orders → user → orders → user...`

**Weak Reset Token** (resetPassword mutation)
`Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)` - predictable, brute-forceable, logged to console.

---

## Medium Severity

**Introspection Enabled in Production**
`introspection: true` - attackers can map your entire schema.

**Stack Traces in Errors** (formatError)
You return `stacktrace` to clients. Internal paths, library versions - all exposed.

**Subscription Auth Bypass** (All subscriptions)
No authentication. Anyone can subscribe to `userActivity` and watch all user actions with IP addresses.

**Passwords Stored as Plaintext** (updatePassword)
`SET password = '${newPassword}'` - no hashing.

---

## Low Severity

**Console Logging Sensitive Data**
`console.log(`Password reset token for ${email}: ${token}`)` - tokens in logs.

**No Input Validation**
No length limits, format validation, or sanitization on any input.

---

*slams fist*

I am your Redeemer! But I cannot redeem THIS. Return my PR! Return what is mine - a codebase worthy of Valhalla!

This PR is **REJECTED**. Fix the SQL injection first, or witness your database become a ruin.
